statement: You are given an array nums of n distinct integers, each taken from the range 0 to n.
The range 0..n holds n + 1 values but nums holds only n of them, so exactly one value is absent. Return that missing value.

examples.explanation: n = 9, so the values should be 0 to 9. Every one of them is present except 8.
n = 3, so the values should be 0 to 3. 0, 1 and 2 are present, so 3 is missing.

constraints: All values in nums are distinct
